caption: The drawing features three fireplace tools arranged vertically: a pair of tongs on the left, a pair of scissors or shears in the center, and a shovel on the right. All three objects are depicted in black and gray tones, suggesting they are made of metal. The handles of each tool are elongated and cylindrical, ending in slightly pointed, rounded knobs. The tongs have two long arms with oval-shaped gripping ends, connected by an ornate, symmetrical handle with a rounded opening. The scissors or shears in the center have a similar handle to the tongs but are shown partially open, with each blade forming a rounded, pointed section. The shovel on the right has a straight handle that widens into a flat blade with gently curved edges and two rivets where the blade meets the handle. Below the tools are two small linear scales labeled "0 1' 2'" with tick marks, and in the bottom left corner of the image, the name "HANS KORSCH" is written. The background is a plain, light beige, and the drawing is bordered by a single-line rectangular frame.
title: Fire Tongs and Shovel
